from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's cash balance as reported in their financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    line_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label from the balance sheet (e.g., 'Cash and cash equivalents', 'Cash and short-term investments')")
    balance_raw: float | None = Field(description="The cash balance as numerically reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed in the document: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period end date of the financial statement")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the balance figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalanceRecord]
